book.name: Nambas
book.title: Nambas Wen Detlot Isreil Pipul Bin Jidan Langa Deset Kantri

content: Mosis bin merrit langa wan gel brom Kush, en blanga tharran na Miriyam en Eran bin mokimbat langa Mosis.
Dubala bin tok, “Yu reken YAWEI det trubala God bin tok oni thru langa Mosis? Imbin tok thru langa minbala du, indit?” Wal YAWEI bin irrim dubala wanim dubala bin toktokbat.
Bat Mosis bin jidan lobala men, mowa lobala langa enibodi langa dijan wel.
Wal streidawei YAWEI bin tok langa Mosis, Eran en Miriyam, “Ai wandim yu thribala blanga kaman langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga main.” En det thribala bin go.
En YAWEI bin kamdan insaid garram det klaud en jandap lida langa det dowawei blanga det Seikridwan Tent, en jingat adbala, “Eran! Miriyam!” Wal dubala bin jandap lida,
en YAWEI bin tok, “Yunbala irrim mi na. Wen ai jandim speshalwan mesinja langa yumob, mi oldei shoum miselp en tok main speshalwan wed langa im langa drim.
Bat im difrin wen ai tok langa main wekinmen Mosis. Aibin pudum im bos blanga ol main Isreil pipul olabat.
Dumaji mi oldei tok langa im feis du feis en nomo trikibalawei, en imbin luk langa mi du. Wal yunbala kaan tok rafwei blanga Mosis.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
YAWEI bin brabli wail langa dubala, en afta imbin gowei na.
Wen det klaud bin libum det Seikridwan Tent, det skin blanga Miriyam bin abum sowa oloba, en im skin bin jidan brabli waitwan na. Wen Eran bin luk det siknis bin spredat oloba langa Miriyam bodi na,
Eran bin tok langa Mosis, “Bos, nomo panishim minbala blanga minbala nogudbalawei.
Nomo larram Miriyam jidan jis laik samting bin bon dedwan weya garram haf bif nomo deya.” Lagijat na Eran bin tok.
Wal Mosis bin lafta krai langa YAWEI, “God, meigim Miriyam gudwan igin.”
En YAWEI bin ensim im, “If im dedi bina spit langa im feis, im lafta abum det panishmen blanga 7 dei. Larram im gowei brom det kemp blanga 7 dei, en afta im gin kambek langa det kemp igin.”
Miriyam bin gowei brom det kemp blanga 7 dei, en detlot pipul nomo bin mub brom det kemp raidap deibin bringimbek Miriyam langa det kemp.
Afta na deibin libum Heiseroth en deibin pudumap kemp langa det deset kantri gulum Paran.
